source.stem:
Multiple choice question: Which of the following statements about gymnosperms and angiosperms is correct ( )
A. The seeds of gymnosperms are covered with pericarp.
B. The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
C. Gymnosperm seeds are exposed
D. The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

options.text: The seeds of gymnosperms are covered by a pericarp
The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

intelligence.enrichment: Living beings share a set of characteristics: they show movement, need food, grow, respire, excrete, respond to stimuli, reproduce, and die; non-living things do not show this set. The classification follows from whether the thing shows the common life processes; inability to exhibit all of them despite food, air, and water being available indicates death. The learner correctly applies this rule: Living beings share a set of characteristics: they show movement, need food, grow, respire, excrete, respond to stimuli, reproduce, and die; non-living things do not show this set. Something is living only if it visibly moves like an animal.
